dataDisclaimer: IMPORTANT: All coordinates and distances are approximate estimates for demonstration purposes during HackIIITD. They have NOT been professionally surveyed. Accessibility statuses labeled 'verified_step_free' are based on best available public information about the Delhi High Court complex, not a professional accessibility audit. 'reported_step_free' indicates information reported by visitors/advocates. 'unknown' means no assessment has been performed. This data should NOT be used for real navigation decisions by people who depend on step-free access without independent on-site verification.
